name: patient_has_finding_of_ischemic_stroke_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has ischemic stroke.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has the clinical finding of ischemic stroke, regardless of type or severity.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have the clinical finding of ischemic stroke.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has the clinical finding of ischemic stroke.

name: patient_age_value_recorded_now_in_years
meaning: Numeric value indicating the patient's current age in years.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current age in years is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the patient's current age in years if it is known and documented.

name: patient_has_finding_of_pregnancy_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has pregnancy as a clinical finding.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has pregnancy as a clinical finding.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have pregnancy as a clinical finding.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has pregnancy as a clinical finding.

name: patient_is_pregnant_now
meaning: Boolean value indicating whether the patient is currently pregnant.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently pregnant.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently not pregnant.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current pregnancy status is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.

name: patient_has_undergone_informed_consent_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has provided informed consent at the current time.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has provided informed consent at the current time.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has not provided informed consent at the current time.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has provided informed consent at the current time.

name: patient_has_finding_of_temporal_bone_window_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a temporal bone window present.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a temporal bone window present.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a temporal bone window present (i.e., absence).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a temporal bone window.
